name: Focus Wall — Bounded 10-Sticky-Note Visual Board in Your Browser Side Panel
summary: Docks a color-coded, drag-and-drop board of up to 10 sticky notes right inside your browser side panel so your active reminders stay visible across every tab you visit.
metaDescription: A calm, hard-capped 10-sticky-note visual board inside your browser side panel. Drag, color-code, and export your active thoughts 100% locally with zero cloud.
